title: CODATA 2022: the atomic mass constant is 1.660 539 068 92 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 52 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. One unified atomic mass unit is this mass.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'atomic mass constant 1.660 539 068 92 e-27' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 52 e-27', in kilograms. The line 'atomic mass unit-kilogram relationship' prints the same digits. This is the mass corresponding to 1 u in that adjustment. It is not exact in the listing.
